title: Encrypted DNS Provisioning RFC 9464 Wire Codec Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned byte-level ENCDNS_IP* and ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO codecs for the implemented RFC 9464 helper surface.
planned_changes:
- Add RFC 9460 service-parameter key/length/value modeling for provisioning attributes.
- Encode and decode ENCDNS_IP* IKEv2 attribute headers and data fields in RFC 9464 order.
- Encode and decode ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO request, reply, set, and ACK forms.
- Validate AliasMode, zero-address reply/set payloads, forbidden hint SvcParams, registered hash identifiers, and digest ADN scoping.
- Add SHA2-256 SPKI digest helper over caller-supplied DER SPKI bytes.
- Add focused unit tests and canonical spec xrefs.
- Narrow the encrypted DNS discovery/provisioning gap to reflect this wire-codec slice.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, the focused encrypted DNS provisioning tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full solution test before commit.
out_of_scope: Full IKEv2 Configuration payload framing and notify/error behavior.
Resolver provisioning behavior, resolver ordering, and split-tunnel policy integration.
TLS certificate extraction and certificate-chain validation.
DHCPv6, DHCPv4, and Neighbor Discovery wire codecs.
completion_notes: The DNS adapter now has a trace-owned RFC 9464 attribute byte codec that future IKEv2 provisioning integration can consume.
